title: Run and manage data replication for Dynamics SL cloud migration

facts.text: Cloud migration setup must be completed before running data replication
Open Cloud Migration Management page and select Run data replication to start migrating data
Monitor progress by checking Migration Log and status fields on Cloud Migration Management page
When data replication is stopped, any already migrated data remains in online database
Generally only data changed since last replication is replicated on subsequent runs
Data replication cannot stop during table migration, waits until current table completes
